Cars + soccer = why does this work so well?

On paper it sounds ridiculous: football with cars. Then you play for five minutes and understand why it's still going strong after all these years.

Ten minutes to learn, a lifetime to master. In your first matches you struggle to even touch the ball; a few months later you're hitting aerials and genuinely feeling good about yourself. It's one of the rare games where you can clearly see yourself improving.

Matches are 5 minutes long, and "just one more" turns into three hours. Free to play, well optimized, runs smoothly on basically anything. Playing 2v2 or 3v3 with friends is the game at its absolute best.

Nothing to buy except cosmetics — zero impact on gameplay.

Just learn to keep your temper in check in ranked. 👌
